events.title: Song of Larithea is in Steam Next Fest, 19 to 26 October
events.summary: The free demo is live on this page all week for Steam Next Fest. What is in the demo: three short tutorials (your first fight, the base, crafting your first spell), then the main quest, Investigate water shortage, six battles across the Ormron desert from the gates of Ormron to the lake. Two side quests start along the way, Name the Dead and The Snake Medallion. The Arena refreshes its fights every day, the challenge board sets new daily challenges, and Auri has a daily reward waiting each time

events.title: Smaller download, new hero art — 9.4.4
events.summary: The demo is smaller to download and install. It carried fonts it never used, and the music now ships in a smaller format. Maya, Nell, Tara, Grey and Dart have new dialogue portraits for every emotion, and new panels in their summer cutscenes. In a fight, Skip stage no longer leaves the camera zoomed in when you press it as the enemy turn ends. The field returns to full view at once. events.title: The Arena pack learns to plan — 9.4.0
events.summary: The best enemy AI I ever played against was in F.E.A.R., a horror shooter from 2005. Each soldier had goals and a planner that chained actions together to reach them. A squad coordinator above the soldiers gave the team one plan: advance, flank or fall back. Jeff Orkin explained how it worked in a 2006 GDC talk called "Three States and a Plan". events.summary: The Arena has daily challenges. The Challenge Herald stands beside the Arena Herald with five new challenges every day, the same for every player, from winning a fight without moving to building a chain of three elements. Each one shows its reward from the start of the day, and a finished challenge waits under Collect until you claim it, on any later day. Both Arena boards now say how long until they refresh. events.title: This week on the demo — 9.1.0
events.summary: Simplified Chinese is in, and it covers the whole game: the interface, and every word of story, from dialogue and quests to journal entries, banter, cutscenes, and the names of enemies, items and spells. Set Steam or your system to Chinese and the game opens in Chinese, or switch it any time in Settings. A long battle now shows on the field itself. events.title: This week on the demo — 9.0.7
events.summary: A memory leak that could crash a long session is fixed — the game used to build up memory as you played and could crash after about an hour mid-fight. It now holds steady no matter how long you play. English button labels stop cutting themselves off, and Maya's attack pose, Tara's default spells, and two panels in the opening cutscene all got new art. events.title: The demo is out
events.summary: The Song of Larithea demo is live. It is free, on Windows and Mac, and it opens Chapter 1 at the edge of the Ormron desert, where the lights are wrong, old spells are waking up, and the water has gone from where it always was. What is in it: turn-based fights on the grid, spell crafting from sigils, and the first stretch of the story with the heroes you start with. English and Russian. What is not in it yet: some animations are missing, and parts of the art still need a consistency pass and more
